note: NECO Economics Paper III round 1: fresh SSCE-standard items with Nigerian institutions and examples (CBN, naira, OPEC, ECOWAS, crude oil, garri and yam), near-duplicate scanned against the JAMB and WAEC banks. Concepts, systems, tools, consumer theory, production, demand and supply, elasticity, markets, business forms, distribution, population, money, finance, public finance, trade, development.
